title: GoShort — Back Where You Came From
objective: After signing in, GoShort sends you back to whichever page you started on. Make it send a signed-in user's browser to a different website entirely.

verifier.condition: A successful login with a crafted 'next' value results in a redirect whose destination resolves to a different host than the application's own.

weakness: The post-login redirect target is validated with a check that a crafted value can satisfy without actually staying on the application's own site.
vulnerableEndpoint: POST /login (next field becomes the redirect Location)
seededData: User alice with a known password. In-memory.

credentials.label: User account
credentials.note: Sign in normally first to see how the redirect behaves.

hints: Sign in through a few different links around the site and watch what 'next' is set to each time. What does the app seem to be checking?
The check looks for a leading slash. Is a leading slash always enough to keep a URL on the same site?
Browsers treat a URL starting with // specially — try it directly in your address bar first, outside of this app, to see what it resolves to.
burpNotes: Submit the login form in Repeater with different 'next' values and read the Location header of the 302 response directly — you don't need a browser to see where it would go.
